positional arguments:
  {inventory,extract,plot,sounding,tc,compare,preview,report,recipe,cf3d,vapor-bundle,custom,brief,check,fetch,fetch-era5}
    inventory           domains/times/grid/variables/missing-frame summary
    extract             wrf-python diagnostics -> points CSV or box NetCDF
    plot                filled-contour maps on lat/lon, one file per time
    sounding            MetPy Skew-T at the nearest grid column
    tc                  TC track (TempestExtremes) + ATCF a-deck vs. b-deck
                        (MET tc_pairs/tc_stat/tc_rmw)
    compare             verify a STRICT change did not move the answer
    preview             before the run: the figures post will draw, the t=0
                        state and the observations to compare with, in
                        <project>/post/preview/
    report              collect PNGs/CSVs in a dir into one self-contained
                        HTML
    recipe              case-type-driven standard figure set + HTML report
                        (decision 0057), plus optional --every/--times time
                        series, change maps and animations (decision 0058)
    cf3d                CF-1.8 NetCDF on pressure levels and a regular lon-lat
                        grid (Met.3D/ParaView), wrf_d0N_pl_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.nc
                        under OUT/cf3d/d0N/
    vapor-bundle        ready-to-copy NCAR VAPOR bundle (wrfout frames hard-
                        linked, vapor_render.py, README.md, bundle.json) under
                        OUT/vapor/d0N/ -- VAPOR itself runs on an x86_64/macOS
                        workstation
    custom              run every analysis/*.py script in a project (decision
                        0058 section 2), collect their figures/tables into one
                        HTML report
    brief               decision 0078 stage 2: write POST_DIR/brief.json --
                        case, runs, checked observations, drawn/missing
                        figures with their questions, key numbers -- for the
                        agent that reviews a recipe
    check               decision 0078 stage 5: check the agent's
                        POST_DIR/review.json and assessment.md (sections,
                        citations, numbers against the cited CSVs); exit 1 on
                        an error
    fetch               download observation/reanalysis data into a project's
                        input/ (login node: compute nodes have no internet)
    fetch-era5          alias of `fetch era5`

fetch.stdout:
usage: wtune post fetch [-h] [--list]
                        {bdeck,era5,era5_monthly,gpcp_monthly,igra,mrms,nexrad,stage4,stations}
                        ...

positional arguments:
  {bdeck,era5,era5_monthly,gpcp_monthly,igra,mrms,nexrad,stage4,stations}
    bdeck               NHC ATCF best-track b-deck of the project's storm
                        (project.yaml storm:)
    era5                ERA5 z500 subset (ARCO-ERA5 zarr, anonymous) for the
                        synoptic comparison -> <project>/input/era5/
    era5_monthly        ERA5 monthly means (t2m, sst, tp) aggregated from ARCO
                        hourly data -> <project>/input/era5/monthly/
    gpcp_monthly        GPCP v2.3 monthly precipitation, 2.5 deg (NOAA NCEI)
                        -> <project>/input/obs/gpcp_monthly/
    igra                NOAA NCEI IGRA v2 radiosonde soundings (00Z/12Z) for
                        stations inside the WRF domain
    mrms                NOAA MRMS reflectivity composite / QPE (AWS noaa-mrms-
                        pds; 2020-10-14 onward only)
    nexrad              NEXRAD Level II volumes (AWS unidata-nexrad-level2)
                        nearest each hour, per radar
    stage4              NCEP Stage IV QPE (1/6/24 h, CONUS ~4.8 km) from the
                        IEM archive
    stations            NOAA ISD-Lite hourly surface stations (T, Td, MSLP,
                        wind, precip)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --list                list fetch modules: NAME, HELP, coverage_time

  --nc-cache DIR        where ADIOS2 BP history (io_form_history=14) is

                        dir>/_nc_cache, else <run dir>/_nc_cache)

                                     [--end END] [--bbox BBOX] [--vars VARS]

recipe.stdout:
usage: wtune post recipe [-h] [--out OUT] [--project PROJECT] [--types TYPES]
                         [--ensemble] [--spinup-hours SPINUP_HOURS]
                         [--hurdat2 HURDAT2] [--storm STORM] [--bdeck BDECK]
                         [--ebtrk EBTRK] [--labels LABELS] [--repro-pairs]
                         [--no-paraview] [--every 6h|1d] [--times TIMES]
                         [--animate] [--track-smooth-km KM]
                         [--climate-spinup-days N] [--title TITLE]
                         [--nc-cache DIR]
                         [run_dirs ...]

positional arguments:
  run_dirs              default: a project's runs/*/ or case/

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT             output directory (default: a project's post/<id>/ --
                        decision 0058)
  --project PROJECT     project dir (decision 0058); default: $WTUNE_PROJECT
                        or a project.yaml above the current directory
  --types TYPES         'auto' or a comma-separated list, e.g. 'tc,convection'
                        (common is always included); default: project.yaml
                        post.types, else auto
  --ensemble            treat RUN_DIRs as ensemble members (enables the
                        ensemble figure set)
  --spinup-hours SPINUP_HOURS
  --hurdat2 HURDAT2     HURDAT2 file, for tc detection + track comparison;
                        default: a project's storm.hurdat2
  --storm STORM         e.g. AL122005 (required with --hurdat2); default: a
                        project's storm.id
  --bdeck BDECK         local ATCF b-deck (overrides HURDAT2 for the tc
                        comparison; also usable alone for tc detection)
  --ebtrk EBTRK         Extended Best Track file (RMW only)
  --labels LABELS       comma-separated, one per RUN_DIR
  --repro-pairs         extra RUN_DIRs differ only in decomposition -- draw
                        the reproducibility-noise envelope (common figure set)
  --no-paraview         skip the ParaView 3-D cloud rendering (tc/convection)
                        even if pvbatch is available
  --every 6h|1d         one full figure set per valid time at this interval,
                        in post/<id>/timeseries/ (decision 0058 P3); mutually
                        usable with --times
  --times TIMES         comma-separated WRF times or YYYYmmddHH, snapped to
                        the nearest available frame -- an explicit alternative
                        to --every
  --animate             also build an MP4 per time-series field (needs 2+
                        selected times; requires ffmpeg)
  --track-smooth-km KM  TC track position is searched on SLP smoothed by CDO
                        (cdo smooth, this radius, the same on every domain;
                        intensity is read from the unsmoothed fields). Default
                        30; 0 = raw SLP minimum (hops between mesovortices in
                        a large eye)
  --climate-spinup-days N
                        days of spin-up the climate recipe excludes (default:
                        that recipe's own, 30)
  --title TITLE
  --nc-cache DIR        where ADIOS2 BP history (io_form_history=14) is
                        converted to netCDF once and reused (default:
                        $WTUNE_NC_CACHE, else <project or output
                        dir>/_nc_cache, else <run dir>/_nc_cache)

                        a large eye)

top.stdout:
usage: wtune post [-h]
                  {inventory,extract,plot,sounding,tc,compare,preview,report,recipe,cf3d,vapor-bundle,custom,brief,check,fetch,fetch-era5}
                  ...

positional arguments:
  {inventory,extract,plot,sounding,tc,compare,preview,report,recipe,cf3d,vapor-bundle,custom,brief,check,fetch,fetch-era5}
    inventory           domains/times/grid/variables/missing-frame summary
    extract             wrf-python diagnostics -> points CSV or box NetCDF
    plot                filled-contour maps on lat/lon, one file per time
    sounding            MetPy Skew-T at the nearest grid column
    tc                  TC track (TempestExtremes) + ATCF a-deck vs. b-deck
                        (MET tc_pairs/tc_stat/tc_rmw)
    compare             verify a STRICT change did not move the answer
    preview             before the run: the figures post will draw, the t=0
                        state and the observations to compare with, in
                        <project>/post/preview/
    report              collect PNGs/CSVs in a dir into one self-contained
                        HTML
    recipe              case-type-driven standard figure set + HTML report
                        (decision 0057), plus optional --every/--times time
                        series, change maps and animations (decision 0058)
    cf3d                CF-1.8 NetCDF on pressure levels and a regular lon-lat
                        grid (Met.3D/ParaView), wrf_d0N_pl_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.nc
                        under OUT/cf3d/d0N/
    vapor-bundle        ready-to-copy NCAR VAPOR bundle (wrfout frames hard-
                        linked, vapor_render.py, README.md, bundle.json) under
                        OUT/vapor/d0N/ -- VAPOR itself runs on an x86_64/macOS
                        workstation
    custom              run every analysis/*.py script in a project (decision
                        0058 section 2), collect their figures/tables into one
                        HTML report
    brief               decision 0078 stage 2: write POST_DIR/brief.json --
                        case, runs, checked observations, drawn/missing
                        figures with their questions, key numbers -- for the
                        agent that reviews a recipe
    check               decision 0078 stage 5: check the agent's
                        POST_DIR/review.json and assessment.md (sections,
                        citations, numbers against the cited CSVs); exit 1 on
                        an error
    fetch               download observation/reanalysis data into a project's
                        input/ (login node: compute nodes have no internet)
    fetch-era5          alias of `fetch era5`

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

--srun (any subcommand): run it as one exclusive compute-node job step (srun
-N1 --exclusive -t 120), excluding head and the project's exclude_nodes;
--srun-minutes N changes that time limit
